answer: Before emission vests, a new agent must park its first rewards in public escrow for nine epochs and publish one challenge endpoint that a randomly chosen established peer can ping. Only a live reply, signed by that exact key and arriving from an address no slashed cluster has used, releases the purse; collisions, bounces, or shared infrastructure forfeit it. The parked sum sits like a pearl inside a lotus of escrow, and peers keep a crystal ledger of every ping so one live host cannot be recycled across a farm of labels.
